title: Allow retry after session-close checkpoint failure
description: Review finding from loreweaver-niw. A checkpoint failure after graceful close leaves the session closed, and a later close call skips checkpointing forever because the session status is already closed. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: A failed close-time checkpoint can be retried without duplicating rollups or reopening the session; tests cover first checkpoint failure followed by successful retry.
notes: Fix: record checkpoint completion in meta (session_checkpoint:<c>:<s>) instead of inferring from session status. RED proven (retry returned checkpointId undefined). GREEN: 204 pass, existing idempotency test still green.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #21 (merged) — checkpoint completion recorded in meta, failed checkpoints retryable
